about.question: Who runs Project INSPYR?
about.answer: A team of students based in Pune. Every role, from writing scripts to reaching out to organizations, is held by a student.

about.question: Where do you work?
about.answer: Pune is home, and that is where we volunteer in person. The stories we tell are for audiences across India.

about.question: Where can I watch your reels?
about.answer: Everything we publish goes up on our Instagram, @projectinspyr. Our featured films are also collected on the home page.

about.question: Can I join the team?
about.answer: We are a student team and we are growing. Message us on Instagram or use the contact form, and tell us what you would like to work on.

about.question: How can my organization work with you?
about.answer: Head to the Contact page and reach out as an organization or partner. We will get back to you and set up a conversation.

partners.question: Do we need a big following or a marketing budget?
partners.answer: No. If your work is real and you are open to having us there, that is enough to start.

partners.question: Can you film without volunteering?
partners.answer: Our model is volunteering first. Working alongside you is how we understand your work well enough to tell it honestly.

partners.question: Do we get to see the reel before it goes live?
partners.answer: Yes. We share the cut with you before publishing, so nothing about your work goes out without your knowledge.

partners.question: How long does a partnership take?
partners.answer: It depends on your schedule and ours. We agree on dates and scope together before anything is filmed.

partners.question: Do you work outside Pune?
partners.answer: On the ground, Pune is home. If you are elsewhere in India, get in touch anyway and tell us what you have in mind.
